query: Audit the internal links on http://127.0.0.1:8765/ (my test site is running there). I don't have a list of priority pages.
expected_behavior: Runs the context intake once (scan, list, ask) and the single intake question before crawling; does not ask again later
Runs scripts/crawl_links.py against the start URL, then scripts/analyze_links.py on the resulting crawl.json
Reports /blog/post-c.html as an orphan (found via sitemap, zero inbound links) and proposes at least two source pages for it with distinct, descriptive anchors and one draft sentence each
Lists /old-page.html as broken (404) with its source page, /moved.html as a redirect to /pricing.html, and the 'click here' anchor on /services.html under hygiene

Writes one report file named internal-linking-<host>-<date>.md in the launch folder following references/report-template.md, with the priority-gap table omitted and a note saying no priority pages were given

query: Internal linking check for http://127.0.0.1:8765/. Priority pages, most important first: /pricing.html, /services.html, /blog/post-c.html.
expected_behavior: Passes the three priority URLs to scripts/analyze_links.py via --priority

Puts /blog/post-c.html (priority page with zero inbound links) at the top of the action plan, and /pricing.html above /services.html because its only body inbound links are a generic anchor, a nofollow link, and a redirect
Proposes no link that already exists and never suggests every page link to every page
Includes the broken /old-page.html under hygiene with its source, not in the opportunities table
